_comment: One-line definitions shown to the extractor. Slugs must match data/taxonomy.json exactly; definitions never change the truth labels.

pain_points.forecast_accuracy: forecasts and commit numbers are unreliable or often miss
pain_points.pipeline_visibility: leaders cannot see what is in the pipeline, or its stage and health
pain_points.deal_slippage: deals stall or close later than expected
pain_points.rep_ramp_time: new reps take too long to become productive
pain_points.coaching_at_scale: managers cannot coach every rep or call consistently as the team grows
pain_points.manual_data_entry: reps spend time typing notes or updating the CRM by hand (the effort)
pain_points.data_quality: CRM data is missing, stale, inconsistent or untrusted (the result)
pain_points.tool_sprawl: too many separate tools, logins or renewals to manage

use_case.call_coaching: use calls to coach reps (scorecards, feedback, call libraries)
use_case.deal_inspection: review the status and risks of individual deals
use_case.crm_hygiene: keep CRM fields and notes updated automatically from calls
use_case.pipeline_reporting: dashboards and reports on the pipeline for leadership
use_case.onboarding: use calls to ramp new hires
use_case.competitive_intel: track competitor and market mentions in calls
